transcript: I'm Almost There is a wonderful one-act song cycle odyssey by Todd Almond at the Minetta Lane Theatre. After an unexpected meet cute in Tribeca, the guy shows up at Todd's apartment building the next morning with coffee and Todd has to make his way downstairs encountering all sorts of obstacles along the way. Sitting at a piano for a good amount of the show, Todd is joined on stage by two amazing musicians and this trio of keys, harp, and bass has a really cool and seductive quality. The music is great and the whole show is really well structured. As it progresses, it gets a little more unconventional narratively, but this keeps it interesting and it never wanders too far. Todd’s songwriting and vocals are always captivating. I'm Almost There is closing tomorrow night, so if this interests you, make haste — but also with Audible presenting this, I believe they'll release an audio recording at some point which I'm already looking forward to. With that, another program for my collection.
